description: This file defines the EscaperNodeVisitor class, a part of the Twig templating engine responsible for handling node traversal and automatic escaping logic within Twig templates.

classes.name: EscaperNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface responsible for traversing Twig nodes to apply auto-escaping strategies during template rendering. It manages escape states, safe analysis, and applies escape filters accordingly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor for safe variable analysis during escape processing.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Handles logic upon entering a node during traversal, setting escape states based on node types.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles logic upon leaving a node during traversal, performing escape application and cleanup.

methods.name: escapeConditional
methods.description: Recursively escapes operands within operator expressions based on the desired escape type.

methods.name: escapeExpression
methods.description: Wraps a given expression with an escape filter if it isn't already safe.

methods.name: preEscapeFilterNode
methods.description: Prepares filter nodes for escaping by checking pre-escape attributes and applying escape filters when necessary.

methods.name: isSafeFor
methods.description: Determines if an expression is considered safe for a given escape type.

methods.name: needEscaping
methods.description: Returns the current escaping status based on the stack or default strategy.

methods.name: getEscaperFilter
methods.description: Constructs an escape filter node with appropriate parameters for the given escape type.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, defaulting to 0.
